comment: Three of the four output jacks are drawn on blank panel with no lettering and no jack artwork: the scale, the chord-change pulse and the scale root. The quantiser splits the input with modf, so a negative fractional part is compared against scale notes that are all positive and the first note of the scale always wins; melody voltages below 0V are therefore rounded to one note per octave. The maker's README says the module does not work fully as intended.
